description: The TakeSix format, validation and layout. TakeSix is an open format and libraries that let an AI agent answer with a diagram you can click into instead of a wall of text: at most six blocks per screen, and any block opens into up to six more.
rules: A TakeSix document is JSON: { "takesix": "1.0", "title", "blocks", "links" }; every level holds at most 6 blocks, placed on a 6×6 grid with "at" (e.g. "A1:B1").
A block opens either into child blocks ("children") or into text ("details"), never both.
Check a document with parseDocument before showing it; it returns ok with the document or a list of issues with JSON paths.
FORMAT.md is the exact specification; the JSON Schema is exported as @takesix/core/schema.json.
